fullTextZH: 今天我们一起去看一个
fullTextEN: Today we will go see a
family's story during the Spring Festival.
Do you know about the Chinese Spring Festival?

fullTextZH: 在春节我们会做什么呢
fullTextEN: What do we do during the Spring Festival?
This is the mother and daughter.
The mother is combing her hair.
The daughter is standing next to the mother.
The mother is wearing red clothes.
The mother and daughter are both at home.
So he must be the father.
It looks like the father just got home.
Dad is pulling a big suitcase.

fullTextZH: 妈妈帮爸爸拿着一个大包
fullTextEN: Mom is helping Dad carry a big bag.

fullTextZH: 爸爸不和妈妈还有女儿住在一起
fullTextEN: Dad doesn't live with Mom and daughter.
He came back for the Spring Festival.

fullTextZH: 爸爸给妈妈和女儿带了很多东西
fullTextEN: Dad brought many things for Mom and daughter.

fullTextZH: 这是爸爸给妈妈买的新衣服
fullTextEN: These are the new clothes Dad bought for Mom.
Dad is holding a cup of tea.

fullTextZH: 一边看自己的老婆和女儿穿新衣服
fullTextEN: Watching his wife and daughter wear new clothes.

fullTextZH: 所以爸爸一年只回来一次
fullTextEN: So Dad only comes back once a year.
Dad is not in his hometown.

fullTextZH: 爸爸在其他的城市工作
所以他一年只回来一次
fullTextEN: So he only comes back once a year.
So they are all very happy.
The daughter also wore a new hat.
Then what did dad go to do?

fullTextZH: 爸爸带着女儿一起去剪头发
fullTextEN: Dad took the daughter to get a haircut together.
So dad also needs a haircut.
The daughter sat nearby eating candy.

fullTextZH: 然后看着爸爸剪头发刮胡子
fullTextEN: Then watched dad get a haircut and shave.

fullTextZH: 爸爸觉得我很喜欢我的头发
fullTextEN: Dad thinks I really like my hair.
The daughter is also very happy.
Her dad is more handsome now.

fullTextZH: 这里看起来是一个小地方
fullTextEN: This place looks like a small area.

fullTextZH: 每家都有很多红色的东西
fullTextEN: Every family has many red things.

fullTextZH: 在春节我们会有很多红色的东西
fullTextEN: During Spring Festival, we will have many red things.

fullTextZH: 爸爸和女儿一起贴贴春联
fullTextEN: Dad and daughter put up Spring Festival couplets together.

fullTextZH: 在这个红色的纸上会写一些很好的话
fullTextEN: On this red paper, some good words will be written.
They are preparing for Spring Festival.

fullTextZH: 然后他们现在在做什么
fullTextEN: Then what are they doing now?
Do you know what this is?
This was made by the daughter.
In the south, we make tangyuan.
In northern China, they make dumplings.
So they are now in the south.
The tangyuan made by the daughter is very cute.

fullTextZH: 为什么我们要把硬币放进汤圆里呢
fullTextEN: Why do we put coins in the dumplings?

fullTextZH: 因为如果你吃到了有硬币的汤圆
fullTextEN: Because if you eat a dumpling with a coin
Then you will be very good
You will have many good things
So if you get a coin
It means you are very lucky

fullTextZH: 女儿最喜欢和爸爸妈妈一起睡觉
fullTextEN: The daughter loves sleeping with her parents
The 7 days of Spring Festival every year

fullTextZH: 因为她可以和爸爸妈妈一起睡觉
fullTextEN: Because she can sleep with her parents

fullTextZH: 她可以每天和爸爸妈妈在一起
fullTextEN: She can be with her parents every day
They get up to have breakfast
So the daughter will be very lucky.

fullTextZH: 他们现在出门和朋友见面
fullTextEN: They are going out to meet friends now.
They bought a lot of things.
They want to give them to family.
This is the daughter's good friend.
This is called a red envelope.
They will give red envelopes to the children.
There is money inside the red envelope.

fullTextZH: 所以小朋友们都很开心
fullTextEN: So the children are all very happy.

fullTextZH: 然后女儿也给她的朋友看了她的硬币
fullTextEN: Then the daughter also showed her friend her coin.
This is a very good thing.

fullTextZH: 他的朋友也想要这个硬币
fullTextEN: His friend also wants this coin.
Will the daughter give it to him?
She will not give it to him.

fullTextZH: 爸爸带着女儿去楼上去楼上
爸爸让女儿坐在他的肩膀上
fullTextEN: Dad let the daughter sit on his shoulders.
It turns out to be a dragon dance.

fullTextZH: 他们会拿着龙一起跳舞
fullTextEN: They will hold the dragon and dance together.
The dragon is the best animal.
Everyone will do the dragon dance.

fullTextZH: 他们都穿着红色的衣服

fullTextEN: Many people are watching the dragon dance.

fullTextZH: 所以爸爸和女儿一起看舞龙
fullTextEN: So the father and daughter watch the dragon dance together.

fullTextZH: 在天上还有很多颜色的气球
fullTextEN: There are also many colorful balloons in the sky.

fullTextZH: 这是我们最开心的时候
然后女儿最喜欢的事情
就是和她的朋友们一起在家外面玩雪
fullTextEN: is playing in the snow outside the house with her friends.

fullTextZH: 她们一起做了一个雪人

fullTextEN: They are playing in the snow together.
What is the daughter looking for?

fullTextZH: 她和她的猫一起找什么
fullTextEN: What are she and her cat looking for together?
That little girl will be very anxious.

fullTextZH: 她可以找到她的硬币吗

fullTextEN: Dad knows the daughter is very sad.

fullTextZH: 所以爸爸又给她一个硬币
fullTextEN: So dad gave her another coin.

fullTextZH: 她只想要她吃到的硬币
fullTextEN: She only wants the coin she got.
The daughter is on the bed.

fullTextZH: 第二天妈妈看起来在哭
fullTextEN: The next day, mom looked like she was crying.

fullTextZH: 很伤心小猫也坐在地上看着妈妈
fullTextEN: Very sad, the kitten also sat on the ground watching mom.
The daughter also stood nearby eating candy.
Why is dad putting on shoes?
Mom is helping dad pack things.
She also doesn't want dad to leave.

fullTextZH: 因为爸爸要一年以后才回来
fullTextEN: Because dad will only come back after a year.
Dad has to go to work.

fullTextZH: 他想让妈妈和女儿有更好的生活
fullTextEN: He wants mom and daughter to have a better life.
She wants to give the coin to dad.

fullTextZH: 可以让爸爸有很多很好的事情
fullTextEN: It can bring dad many good things.
It can make dad very lucky.
So the daughter gives it to dad.

fullTextZH: 最后女儿和妈妈一起送爸爸走
fullTextEN: Finally, the daughter and mom see dad off together.
We will wait for you to come back at home.
